title: Queen's Gambit: the ideas
line: White offers a side pawn to pull Black's center pawn away.

steps.text: Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares. It takes the center and frees your bishop.

also.e2e4: That is the most played first move, the king pawn opening. This lesson plays the queen pawn.
also.c2c4: That is the English Opening, also sound. This lesson plays the queen pawn.
also.g1f3: That is the knight first, often a Réti Opening. This lesson plays the queen pawn.

steps.text: Push the pawn on c2 two squares, offering it. It attacks Black's center pawn from the side.

also.g1f3: That keeps the gambit for later, also sound. This lesson offers the pawn now.
also.c1f4: That is the London System, also sound. This lesson offers the side pawn.

steps.after: This is the Queen's Gambit. Black guards the center pawn with another pawn.

steps.text: Bring the knight out to add pressure on d5.

also.g1f3: That brings the other knight out, also sound. This lesson brings this knight first.
also.c4d5: That is the Exchange Variation, also sound. This lesson brings the knight out first.
also.g2g3: That heads for the Catalan, also sound. This lesson brings the knight out first.

steps.after: Black's knight guards the pawn too.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out to attack that knight. Behind the knight stands the queen.
steps.after: Black's bishop shields the queen. White's pawn and knight both attack the center pawn.

steps.text: If Black takes the offered pawn, its center pawn has left the middle. White pushes the king's pawn two squares and takes the center.
A common mistake: Black brings the knight out at once. If White takes on d5, no black pawn can take back.
Take on d5 with your pawn.
steps.after: The knight takes back, but in the center it can be chased by pawns.

steps.text: Push the pawn in front of your king two squares. It chases the knight and takes the center.
steps.after: Two white pawns in the center, none for Black.

summary: A side pawn attacks Black's center pawn. Black holds the center with another pawn, or gives it up.
